evidence.claim: Fabrinet's March 2026 quarter disclosed optical communications revenue of $888.7 million, representing 73.2% of total revenue; disclosed optical categories included telecom, datacom, and datacenter interconnect.

Fabrinet defines datacenter interconnect modules as opto-electronic modules used to connect two or more geographically separated data centers, and defines HPC products as systems built from interconnected processors, accelerators, high-speed memory, and low-latency networking.

Coherent's FY2025 annual report says networking R&D included 800G/1.6T datacom transceivers, CPO, VCSELs, EMLs, silicon photonics, ICs, isolators, thermoelectric coolers, and components supporting future 3.2T and 6.4T links.
Coherent's FY2025 annual report says it is developing an optical circuit switch product family for AI/ML and hyperscale datacenters based on digital liquid-crystal technology.

Lumentum's FY2025 results showed Cloud & Networking revenue of $1.4108 billion, up 30.0% year over year, indicating it is also a relevant optical-networking candidate, though not selected in the top-five candidate list for this pass.
evidence.source_title: Lumentum Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Fiscal Year 2025 Results

memory_update.text: Add MRVL, CRDO, ALAB, FN, and COHR as priority US-listed candidates for the AI networking and optical-interconnect node.

The node should be split into sublayers for future passes: switch/NIC silicon, AEC/copper short-reach, optical DSPs, optical transceiver/component suppliers, optical manufacturing services, and fabric observability/software.

LITE, CIEN, APH, TEL, MTSI, ONDS/POET-class smaller photonics names, and private/foreign optical module suppliers were not fully expanded in this five-name pass and should be covered in a dedicated optics/components pass.

Customer mapping remains incomplete: hyperscaler design wins, customer concentration, and whether revenue is tied to AI training clusters, inference clusters, telecom, or general datacenter refresh need primary-source confirmation.

node: AI networking, Ethernet/InfiniBand fabrics, switch ASICs, NICs, optics, and interconnect
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the AI networking and optical-interconnect node beyond the seed list. The most relevant second-order mappings are: high-speed DSP/SerDes and custom interconnect silicon, AEC copper interconnects, PCIe/CXL/Ethernet retimers and smart fabric modules, optical transceiver/component suppliers, and outsourced optical-manufacturing capacity. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
